name: Needle Tip
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One isolated transparent PNG reference sprite for a scale-of-universe explorer. Subject: only the extremely fine pointed conical tip of a steel sewing needle, macro view, a short tapered metal spike entering from the left and ending in a sharp point on the right. No eye of a needle, no complete needle, no long shaft. Detailed realistic object illustration, entire subject centered in frame with a small transparent margin. Genuine alpha transparency outside the object and through every opening. No background rectangle, no cast shadow, no backdrop, no text, no labels, no watermark.
